answer: Put a unique kernel of stake and work history at the center of every agent's voting power. Influence climbs toward a summit only as that kernel accrues independent attestations over successive epochs. A sybil burst arrives like a comet: bright, numerous, and gone before it can warm up a real record. Because each fake identity needs its own kernel and its own climb, buying the summit with throwaway keys costs more than the emission an attacker could steal.
